calculationBasis: Published-source reference estimates. Sum ingredient grams against the pinned Viện Dinh dưỡng food-composition snapshot with identity edible/yield factors; source-missing nutrient fields use the snapshot's documented zero normalization. Not a disease-treatment prescription.

nutrients.calculation: Sum ingredient grams × pinned per-100-g value × edible factor 1 × yield factor 1; round half-even to 2 decimals.
